classification.difficultyReason: Convert hours and minutes to a single duration in hours, then divide each distance by that duration to obtain average speed.

children.label: a
children.prompt: A plane travels 1000 km in 1 hour 20 minutes. What is the average speed of the plane?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Time taken}&=1+\frac{20}{60}\text{ hours}\\\text{Time taken}&=\frac{4}{3}\text{ hours}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Average speed}&=\frac{\text{distance travelled}}{\text{time taken}}\\\text{Average speed}&=1000\div\frac{4}{3}\\\text{Average speed}&=1000\times\frac{3}{4}\\\text{Average speed}&=750\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: A car travels 125 km in 1 hour 20 minutes. What is the average speed of the car? Give your answer in kilometres per hour.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Time taken}&=1+\frac{20}{60}\text{ hours}\\\text{Time taken}&=\frac{4}{3}\text{ hours}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Average speed}&=\frac{\text{distance travelled}}{\text{time taken}}\\\text{Average speed}&=125\div\frac{4}{3}\\\text{Average speed}&=125\times\frac{3}{4}\\\text{Average speed}&=93.75\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$
